item.title: Real Sociedad Beat Barca As La Liga Title Race Tightens
item.description: Real Sociedad: Real Sociedad beat FC Barcelona 2-1 at home to cut Barcelona's lead at the top of La Liga to one point after Real Madrid won a day earlier.

item.title: Atharva Taide's Ton And Fine Bowling Help Vidarbha Beat Saurashtra To Win Vijay Hazare Trophy
item.description: Vijay Hazare Trophy Final: Atharva Taide struck a century while pacers Yash Thakur and Nachiket Bhute shared seven wickets between them as Vidarbha defeated Saurashtra by 38 runs in the final to claim the Vijay Hazare Trophy 2025-26 at the BCCI Centre of Excellence Ground 1 in Bengaluru on Sunday.

item.title: Aus Open: Gauff Brushes Past Uzbekistan's Rakhimova To Reach Second Round
item.description: Rod Laver Arena: Coco Gauff, the No. 3 seed, opened her Australian Open 2026 campaign with a straight-sets 6-2, 6-3 win over Kamilla Rakhimova at Rod Laver Arena on Monday.

item.title: Gujarat Giants vs Royal Challengers Bengaluru, Match 12, WPL 2026, Who will win today GG-W vs RCB-W match?
item.description: Gujarat Giants and Royal Challengers Bengaluru will take on each other in the next game of the WPL 2026 on Monday at BCA Stadium.

item.title: Aus Open: Medvedev Races Into Second Round, Beats Jesper De Jong
item.description: Former World No: Former World No. 1 Daniil Medvedev showcased strong form on Monday at the Australian Open, comfortably defeating Jesper de Jong 7-5, 6-2, 7-6(2) to advance to the second round.

item.title: Afghanistan vs West Indies, 1st T20I - Who will win today AFG vs WI match?
item.description: Afghanistan and West Indies will take on each other in the first T20I on Monday at 8 PM IST at Dubai International Cricket Stadium.

item.title: Aus Open: Auger-Aliassime Retires Mid-way, De Minaur Wins; Pegula Prevails
item.description: Rod Laver Arena: Seventh seed Felix Auger-Aliassime was forced to retire with cramp during his first-round match at the Australian Open on Monday, handing Portugal’s Nuno Borges a 3-6, 6-4, 6-4 lead and a victory.

item.title: Beardman, Edwards Named In Australia's Squad For Pakistan T20ls
item.description: Pakistan T20ls: Australia have announced a squad for the T20I series against Pakistan, starting on January 31 in Lahore, with Mahli Beardman and Jack Edwards included in the 17-player touring group following their performance in the Big Bash League.

item.title: Four Referees Officiating Match Ahead Of Lionel Messi's Kolkata Event Summoned By IFA
item.description: The Indian Football Association: Four referees who officiated a football match at Salt Lake Stadium in Kolkata on December 13, ahead of Argentine football icon Lionel Messi’s appearance, have come under scrutiny for allegedly doing so without prior approval from the competent authorities.

item.title: ‘Batters Failed To Convert Starts, Fielding Was Not Up To The Mark,’ Admits Gill After ODI Series Loss To NZ
item.description: And New Zealand: After India suffered a home ODI series defeat 1-2 against New Zealand, captain Shubman Gill conceded that the team fell short in all departments, admitting that the batters failed to convert their starts and that fielding standards throughout the series were "not up to the mark."
